items.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love (questionable, ankle sprain) is expected to play vs Chargers.
items.why: Corroborates earlier beat expectation; high-ankle sprain recovery progressing to play.
items.implication: Rookie likely shares or sees significant work behind/with Allgeier; monitor exact role/goal-line.
items.opportunity: Carries, possible receiving work; limits pure Allgeier upside if full go.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (questionable, MCL sprain/knee) is not expected to play vs Lions today despite full participation late in the week; sources say he was not quite ready.
items.why: Full participant late week but sources indicate not ready for game action.
items.implication: Major upgrade for Saints backfield volume, especially passing downs and overall snaps.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets/snaps for Travis Etienne and any other backs like Kendre Miller/Devin Neal.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (questionable, calf) is expected to play today vs Panthers, per source.
items.why: Source confirmation after limited practices all week; player previously stated plans to play.
items.implication: Maintains WR role in Bears offense; reduces risk of full absence but monitor snaps if limited.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full route share if active; reverse any prior Burden/Loveland/Swift over-ownership assumptions.

items.text: Less than 24h from lock: very important player-specific discussions in ETR Slack (context includes Jeanty clearance, Bowers OUT, GL notes, Kamara/Etienne, docks).
items.why: Internal high-value talks flagged publicly for subscribers on key statuses/roles.
items.implication: Actionable for DFS/season-long locks on cleared players and beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Jeanty volume, Mayer TE stream, Etienne if Kamara sits.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers questionable (knee); team elevated Braxton Berrios and signed Dalen Cambre from PS as contingency.
items.why: Full practices but Q designation; returning from ACL; elevations signal caution for SNF.
items.implication: If OUT/limited, targets to Fields/Mooney/Berrios; if IN, still not 100%.
items.opportunity: Malachi Fields or others if scratch; Likely TE upside noted elsewhere if Nabers limited.

items.text: Falcons QB Tua Tagovailoa OUT (oblique); Cooper Rush will start vs Steelers despite Saturday back spasms.
items.why: Oblique injury; Rush confirmed starter post-spasms.
items.implication: Falcons offense downgraded; check skill player usage under Rush.
items.opportunity: Possible checkdown/TE or short-area WR boost; lower overall ceiling.

items.text: ETR/Thorman Week 1 snaps & pace: Up in pace NO@DET; slow slogs MIA@LV. Updated for Tua/Bowers news. CHI/CAR total jumped.
items.why: Pace models adjusted for injuries/absences; NO-DET high volume potential, MIA-LV low.
items.implication: Higher play volume for Saints/Lions skill players; lower for Dolphins/Raiders.
items.opportunity: Etienne/Kamara (if in) or Lions backs/WRs in up-tempo; Jeanty still strong but slower game.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (ankle) fully cleared, full practices, off injury report, good to go vs Dolphins; workhorse expected though possible early management.
items.why: Full participant all week post-scary practice injury; self-reported 100%.
items.implication: RB1/high-end RB2 with volume vs soft MIA run D; Bowers OUT funnels more offense his way.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry/target share; monitor Washington Jr. for any committee.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim; expected 1-2 weeks minimum. Confirmed across reports.
items.why: Meniscus procedure mid-week; coach confirmed out.
items.implication: Primary TE targets shift; strong streamer opportunity.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated to TE1 role with higher route/target share (prior 24% without Bowers).

items.text: Raiders DE Maxx Crosby will play today; post-trade saga he told teams including Rams he did not want to be traded.
items.implication: LV defense strength intact vs MIA; minor for fantasy offense.

items.text: Falcons edge Za'Darius Smith (Q, shoulder, limited) should be good to go vs Steelers barring setback.
Matthew Berry keeping Chuba Hubbard open as viable flex this week ('The Chubbler'); not full lock but playable.
items.why: Flex consideration amid Panthers backfield (Brooks cleared but lingering notes).
items.implication: Viable RB flex/start in deeper or PPR; monitor Brooks split.
items.opportunity: Carries in favorable spot; keep roster spot open.

items.text: Cowboys RB Malik Davis to IR (hip); leaves Javonte Williams as clear lead with limited depth.
items.why: Hip injury Friday practice leading to IR.
items.implication: Javonte locked as primary; high snap share.
items.opportunity: Williams RB2/flex lock with committee removed.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Isaiah Likely strong (4th in FPP target last 3 yrs; 8/9 games 6+ tgts = 12.5+ PPR). Nabers not 100% W1; Giants WR2 Fields/Mooney. Gimme all the Likely.
items.why: Usage efficiency + Nabers uncertainty elevates Likely targets.
items.implication: Strong TE stream/start if Nabers limited or for volume.
items.opportunity: Target share bump in BAL offense.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Saquon Barkley vs WAS historically elite (136.5 rush yds, 6.0 YPC, 21+ PPR in 4 games incl playoffs). Commanders front still below avg.
Berry 10 Facts: Chris Olave with Tyler Shough averaged 29% target share, 14.7+ PPR in 75% of those games. Lions safeties on IR; high O/U game.
items.implication: WR2/flex with target upside even if Kamara out boosts pass game.

items.text: Berry 10 Facts: Parker Washington when 70%+ routes averaged 24% target share; career 16.4 PPG at 15%+ share. Browns CB Ward on Brian Thomas.
Berry 10 Facts: When MHJ 50%+ snaps, Michael Wilson 5.5 PPG/13% share; off field Wilson 28% share. MHJ expected to play.
items.why: Clear target cannibalization data when both active.
items.implication: Fade Wilson if MHJ full go; MHJ preferred.
